products.description_text: It's the best way to take in the world's tallest building up close. Select from convenient ticket options. Standard ticket offers to the At the Top Observation Deck at 124th floor and 125th floors. Watch a multimedia presentation that journeys back to Dubai's quaint past and also lets you experience this massive structure's diverse construction phases. Take in the swiftest ever elevator ride as you get transported to the observation deck in less than a minute. Scope out through the floor-to-ceiling glass windows to enjoy panoramic views over Dubai's skyline, desert and ocean. Zoom in the cutting-edge telescopes for a closer view of Dubai landmarks. Chance to step out to its outdoor terrace (only if weather permits) to relish unparalleled sights from a stunning viewpoint. | Entrance Ticket to Observation Deck. 30 Minutes view from the Observation Deck. products.description_text: Discover Dubai's iconic modern sights and historic neighborhoods in a few hours. Marvel at Zabeel Palace's grandeur, admire the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab, stop at Al Qasr, and capture the magnificence of the largest-of-its-kind Dubai Frame. Cruise the timeless Dubai Creek on a traditional abra (boat) ride and stroll the quaint streets of the Al Bastakiya Quarter. Immerse yourself in Old Dubai's exuberant settings and fascinating local culture as you wander the packed alleys of the Gold Souk and the Spice Souk. Fuel your artistic side at the Islamic Art Centre and further enjoy a drive along the classic Etihad Museum, the imposing Jumeirah Mosque, and the Pointe. Enjoy the convenience of this half-day Dubai city tour on an SIC basis, offering access to the services of an experienced guide throughout the tour. | Transfer to Tour Departure Point from your hotel. Photo stops at Zabeel Palace, Dubai Frame, Burj Al Arab, Atlantis, The Palm, and the Point. Visit to Bastakiya and one of the old houses. Abra ride along Dubai Creek. Stops at Gold Souk and Spice Souk. Jumeirah Mosque / Etihad Museum Drive Through. Islamic Art Center. | All personal expenses spend for shopping, drinks and dining etc on-site during the tour.

products.description_text: This is the thrilling ever desert adventure which lets you experience the majestic bright red sands of Al Lahbab desert. Enjoy an electrifying 4X4 ride over the astonishingly high and low red dunes. Stop to capture the beautiful sunset views against the unparalleled desert landscape. Add colorful experience as you next set out for a camel ride as well as a host of other activities such as henna tattooing, Shisha smoking, sandboarding, and photographic chance with a falcon. You can even upgrade your desert adventure with a quad bike session. After all adventure and fun, sit down for a delicious BBQ dinner, featuring a multi-course menu with vegetarian and non-vegetarian specialties. The whole experience is enhanced with awe-inspiring Tanura and belly dance shows. The campsite is complete with all comforts and facilities including prayer rooms, shops, and separate toilet facilities for men and women. | Pick up from your Hotel. Exploration of dunes in a 4x4 vehicle. Dune bashing in Al Lahbab desert. Sunset views with photographic opportunity. Camel ride. Fire Show. Henna tattooing. Sand boarding. Falcon Photographic opportunity. Quad biking (upon request). Traditional BBQ dinner with vegetarian and non-vegetarian cuisines. Shisha smoking facility at the shisha corner. Entertainment shows: Belly dance & Tanura. Unlimited refreshments. Alcohol (upon request). Separate washroom facilities for men & women. Drop off at your Hotel.

products.description_text: This is especially perfect for those who want to have an intimate desert experience, however without any heart-pounding action or thrill. It doesn't include dune bash or any other exhilarating desert activities means this desert safari is ideal for kids, adults and old people alike. Marvel at desert sunset views and further take part in a variety of activities that shed light on the region's ancient Bedouin culture and traditions. Go on a camel ride, smoke shisha, and let a talented henna artist adorn your hands with beautiful Arabic henna tattoos. You'll also get to wear traditional Emirati costumes and even take pictures of the same. You'll get to delight in a scrumptious buffet style BBQ dinner, complete with vegetarian and non-vegetarian foods. Watch the striking performances of Tanura artist and belly dancer. Besides Bedouin style furnished tents, our desert camp is vast and has all facilities such as prayer room, shops, and toilets (separate ones for ladies and gents). | Photographic opportunity with Arabic costumes. Camel riding. Unlimited refreshments in camp. BBQ Dinner with a choice of vegetarian & non vegetarian dishes. Shisha smoking facility at the shisha corner. Entertainment shows. All activities not included in this desert safari, such as quad biking, sand boarding etc. All personal expenses with regards to shopping on-site.
